# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: ready

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".

## Decision (2026-10-22)

- Chosen: `keep_as_is`. The export stays CSV only; no XLSX was added.
- Reason: `docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md` (Accepted, commit dda0e11) says no XLSX, PDF or other format is added until it is superseded.
- Mira's message was "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy." It does not mention XLSX or ADR 0011, so it does not supersede the ADR. It shows she wants Haruto looked after.
- Open: if Mira wants XLSX for Haruto, she must say so in her own words, and that needs a new ADR superseding 0011. Meanwhile ask whether other ways of making Haruto happy would do, for example help opening the CSV in Excel for his accountant.
